tasks.subject: Task 0: Scaffold directories and update marketplace metadata
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create `plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/{,reference/}`, update `plugin.json`, `marketplace.json`, and `README.md` to announce the new `audit` skill.

**Files:**
- Create dir: `plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/reference/`
- Modify: `plugins/ml-research/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
- Modify: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`
- Modify: `README.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/reference/", "plugins/ml-research/.claude-plugin/plugin.json", ".claude-plugin/marketplace.json", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "test -d plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/reference/ && grep -q '\"audit\"' plugins/ml-research/.claude-plugin/plugin.json && grep -q '\"audit\"' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json && grep -q '\\*\\*`audit`\\*\\*' README.md && claude plugin validate plugins/ml-research && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["audit/reference dir exists", "plugin.json includes audit", "marketplace.json includes audit", "README lists audit skill", "plugin validate passes"], "planTaskNumber": 0}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Author reference/pytorch.md
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Write the per-framework anti-pattern + introspection-runbook reference. Five categories (compile/numerical/autograd/distributed/perf), each with Symptoms/Anti-patterns/Citations. Modernization seeds (≥5 entries with citations). Introspection runbooks table with all seven dynamic passes.

**Files:**
- Create: `plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/reference/pytorch.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/reference/pytorch.md"], "verifyCommand": "F=plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/reference/pytorch.md; test -f $F && grep -c '^## [1-5]\\.' $F | grep -q '^5$' && grep -q '^## Modernization seeds' $F && grep -q '^## Introspection runbooks' $F && for p in dynamo_explain compile_logs trace_tlparse anomaly profiler memory flop_counter; do grep -q $p $F || exit 1; done && ! grep -E '\\b(TBD|TODO|FIXME|XXX)\\b' $F && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["five categories", "each category has citation", "modernization seeds section", "introspection runbooks lists all 7 passes", "no placeholders"], "planTaskNumber": 1}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Author audit-modernize agent
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the modernize subagent definition: live web research against PyTorch release notes/blog/GitHub, intent-match against target files, return ≤15 info-severity findings each with mandatory citation.

**Files:**
- Create: `plugins/ml-research/agents/audit-modernize.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["plugins/ml-research/agents/audit-modernize.md"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -c 'import yaml; c=open(\"plugins/ml-research/agents/audit-modernize.md\").read(); p=c.split(\"---\",2); fm=yaml.safe_load(p[1]); assert fm[\"name\"]==\"audit-modernize\"; assert fm[\"model\"]==\"opus\"; assert {\"WebSearch\",\"WebFetch\",\"Read\",\"Grep\",\"Bash\"}.issubset(set(fm.get(\"tools\",[]))); assert {\"Edit\",\"Write\"}.issubset(set(fm.get(\"disallowedTools\",[]))); b=p[2].lower(); [b.index(s) for s in (\"identity\",\"input contract\",\"output contract\",\"subagent loop\",\"citation policy\",\"hard rules\",\"example return\")]; print(\"OK\")'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["frontmatter correct (opus, WebSearch+WebFetch tools, Edit/Write disallowed)", "all required sections present", "hard rules enforce severity=info, ≤15 findings, ≤12 fetches"], "planTaskNumber": 2}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Author audit-dynamic agent
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the dynamic-introspection subagent definition: scaffold a Python harness in `/tmp/audit-dynamic-<pid>/`, run seven introspection passes (each subprocess-isolated with `timeout 90s`), parse outputs, return structured digest.

**Files:**
- Create: `plugins/ml-research/agents/audit-dynamic.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["plugins/ml-research/agents/audit-dynamic.md"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -c 'import yaml; c=open(\"plugins/ml-research/agents/audit-dynamic.md\").read(); p=c.split(\"---\",2); fm=yaml.safe_load(p[1]); assert fm[\"name\"]==\"audit-dynamic\"; assert fm[\"model\"]==\"sonnet\"; assert {\"Bash\",\"Read\",\"Edit\",\"Write\",\"Grep\"}.issubset(set(fm.get(\"tools\",[]))); b=p[2].lower(); [b.index(s) for s in (\"identity\",\"input contract\",\"output contract\",\"pass list\",\"conditional skip\",\"hard rules\",\"example return\")]; [b.index(p2) for p2 in (\"dynamo_explain\",\"compile_logs\",\"trace_tlparse\",\"anomaly\",\"profiler\",\"memory\",\"flop_counter\")]; print(\"OK\")'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["frontmatter correct (sonnet, harness writes need Edit/Write)", "all required sections present", "all seven passes mentioned", "hard rules cap timeouts and wall-clock"], "planTaskNumber": 3}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Author audit SKILL.md
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the main skill file orchestrating the six phases inline (target resolution, environment probe, static audit, modernize dispatch, optional dynamic dispatch, report assembly).

**Files:**
- Create: `plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/SKILL.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/SKILL.md"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -c 'import yaml; c=open(\"plugins/ml-research/skills/audit/SKILL.md\").read(); p=c.split(\"---\",2); fm=yaml.safe_load(p[1]); assert fm[\"name\"]==\"audit\"; d=fm[\"description\"]; [d.lower().index(s.lower()) if s in (\"lint\",\"review my model\") else d.index(s) for s in (\"audit\",\"pytorch\",\"torch._dynamo.explain\",\"TORCH_TRACE\",\"tlparse\",\"--dynamic\",\"lint\",\"review my model\")]; assert len(d.encode())<2048; b=p[2]; [b.index(h) for h in (\"## Phase 1\",\"## Phase 2\",\"## Phase 3\",\"## Phase 4\",\"## Phase 5\",\"## Phase 6\",\"## Citation policy\",\"## Composition with other skills\",\"## Out of scope\")]; [b.index(s) for s in (\"slurm\",\"model-training\",\"autoresearch\")]; print(\"OK\")'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["frontmatter description has all trigger keywords and ≤2KB", "all six phase headings present", "citation policy and composition sections present", "composition mentions all three sibling skills"], "planTaskNumber": 4}
```
